missingHistoricalInventory: The exact old properties labels, referenced inventory and bytes are unknown. None is asserted recovered, and none is a hosted acceptance gate.
sourceMaterialization: Check out each public commit with core.autocrlf=false; apply its exact patch with git apply --index; git write-tree must equal its sourceTree. This preserves the two retained source trees without a new runtime candidate.
bindingContract: Only the declared path/executable tokens are rebound. Fixed artifact bytes, source trees, work counts, selectors, settings and call order remain unchanged. Record actual hosted paths, Java providers/versions, hardware and all call exits.
historicalEvidencePaths: Embedded local paths in the provenance and original records are archival references, not hosted filesystem prerequisites. Actual invocations use the declared bound tokens; do not require old owner directories or private indexes.

tokens.COMMON: Materialized baseline source workspace; all controls/collections/processors use its one shared fixture and collector.
tokens.CANDIDATE: Materialized candidate source workspace; supplies only its three runtime archives.
tokens.FIXTURE_INPUTS: New hosted properties file containing the four derived provenance inputs; rebind paths only.
tokens.BOUNDED_INIT: Existing bounded Gradle init with the main/included root paths rebound; preserve effective caps and verifier runtime substitution.
tokens.JDK17: Temurin 17.0.18+8 toolchain; actual verifyHistoricalWorkloads JavaExec origin was this JDK.
tokens.JDK25: Oracle 25.0.2 admitted Gradle launcher home; retain the original provider/version.
tokens.GRADLE_USER_HOME: Hosted Gradle dependency cache; resolve the same pinned control JAR bytes using their cache-relative paths.

profile.normalization: Per declared batch; preserve count and repeats including10000 clean frames

controls: All14 typed guard/mutation/clean/timed/dirty/nested/high-rate cases retained; no row subset

metrics.elapsed: Actual avgt and sample p50/p95/p99 via existing processor
metrics.allocation: Actual gc.alloc.rate.norm B/op and supported secondary metrics
metrics.gc: Actual gc.count and gc.time when supported; unavailable never zero
metrics.threadCpu: Unavailable in unchanged path; disclose, no start gate or custom timer

propertiesRebinding: Generate the same four labels from the same four files at their hosted absolute paths; retain hosted properties bytes/hash alongside the original local derived properties identity.

requiredHostedPreparation.byteIdentityRule: Preserve or reproduce the pinned bytes and verify actual hashes. A mismatching hosted rebuild does not replace a frozen pin or count as measurement evidence.

routinePrCi: Heavy comparative collections run only for a manual explicit request in one hosted Windows job, never automatically for other PRs.

legacyPreflight.reason: Old owner checkout and next-ready.json are missing; old private-index/packet requirements are not hosted gates.

sharedToolingDraftStatus: Uncommitted, unexecuted resource-wrapper draft for the new shared-tooling owner to review or reuse; no workflow edit was made.
sharedToolingDraftLimitations: Only PowerShell AST parsing was checked; no native call, job release, timeout or stdout behavior was executed.

The draft parent checks RAM before creating the caller. The final shared tool must also recheck RAM inside the owning job immediately before Java; this draft is not accepted as an executable implementation.
boundedInitAdaptation: Rebind only its two main/included root literals for the baseline and candidate preparation calls; keep daemon 768MiB/1024MiB, JavaExec 768MiB/384MiB, fork inheritance, worker/javac/Test 512MiB/256MiB and actual three-JAR verifier substitution. Its stale source-only comments do not constitute evidence.
genericToolingNeeds: Manual request selection, not a benchmark-specific build-script edit
One runner for both sides and both modes
Source commit plus exact patch materialization
Path and Java-home binding without old owner/index gates
Effective JVM caps for all children and a fresh 4096MiB RAM guard inside the owning 3GiB Job
One 1800s native call plus 30s cleanup budget, with failure stopping the next call
Original shared JMH/collector/processor execution and immutable artifact preservation
